question: Which of the following sports is played by Dipika Pallikal Karthik?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Squash**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dipika Pallikal is one of the first Indian women to make a significant mark in international squash, helping to elevate the sport's popularity in India.
 
• She became the first Indian woman to break into the top 10 of the Professional Squash Association (PSA) world rankings in 2012.
 
• She won gold medals in Women's Doubles at the 2014 Commonwealth Games and again at the 2022 Commonwealth Games.
 
• Dipika has won multiple medals at the Asian Games, including a bronze medal in the individual event at the 2014 Incheon Asian Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
